Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 22-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Rourkela is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B. Tech with an M.Tech degree in relevant Food Engineering or Agricultural Engineering disciplines with a minimum CGPA of 6.5/10.0 or 60% aggregate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the JRF post is 28 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Rourkela JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITR/SR/2026/Advt. - 26FP002/I/075.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is on a contractual basis.
